description: This file defines a class 'NotoSans' in the 'PdfSharp.Features.Drawing' namespace, containing a method 'Load_all_Noto_Sans' which loads and renders multiple Noto Sans font files into a PDF document, demonstrating font processing and rendering capabilities.

classes.name: NotoSans
classes.description: A class representing a feature for loading and rendering all Noto Sans fonts within a PDF document.

methods.name: Load_all_Noto_Sans
methods.description: Loads all font files from the specified Noto Sans font directory, renders sample text with each font, and saves the result as a PDF.
